words.sense: Concerned with general concepts or ideas rather than particular physical things.
misconceptions: Anything about ideas must be difficult to understand.

words.sense: Hard to understand because of technical complexity or obscurity.
misconceptions: Anything difficult to read is abstract.

semantic_axes.description: Whether something concerns ideas rather than physical examples, or is intrinsically hard to comprehend.

edges.boundary_rule: Abstract means conceptual rather than physical; abstruse means difficult to comprehend.

misconceptions.M1: Anything about ideas must be difficult to understand.
misconceptions.M2: Anything difficult to read is abstract.
misconceptions.M3: Presentation or author prestige determines conceptual versus difficult.

beats.reason: The situation shows discusses a general principle rather than a thing, which points to abstract.
